SIDEKIT feature extraction notice
=================================

The optional song-classifier sidecar adapts the signal framing, filter-bank,
and normalization procedure published by the SIDEKIT project.

Source: https://github.com/DeepMine-ML/sidekit
License: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 or any later version
Included license texts: LGPL-3.0.txt and GPL-3.0.txt

The adapted implementation is shipped as readable Python source at
backend/audio/song-classifier-sidecar.py so recipients can inspect, modify,
and replace it. No SIDEKIT model weights or binary artifacts are bundled.
